# Titanium UI

> Titanium UI is a modern, themeable React component library built on Radix UI primitives with Tailwind CSS styling. It provides 50+ production-ready, accessible components with 6 built-in color themes and light/dark mode support.

Package: `@e412/titanium`
Based on: [ReUI](https://reui.io)

## Getting Started

- [Installation](/docs/installation.md): How to install and set up Titanium UI in your React project
- [Theming](/docs/theming.md): Customize colors, typography, and design tokens using CSS variables
- [Dark Mode](/docs/dark-mode.md): Implement light/dark mode with system preference detection
- [Themes](/docs/themes.md): Available pre-built themes and how to use them

## UI Components

These are custom-built components for specialized functionality:

- [Calendar](/docs/components/calendar.md): Date picker with range selection, keyboard navigation, and localization support
- [Data Grid](/docs/components/data-grid.md): Powerful data table built on TanStack Table with sorting, filtering, pagination, and drag-and-drop row reordering
- [Filters](/docs/components/filters.md): Filter controls for data filtering with multiple filter types
- [Form](/docs/components/form.md): Form handling with React Hook Form integration and Zod validation
- [Kanban](/docs/components/kanban.md): Drag-and-drop kanban board built on DnD Kit for project management workflows
- [Marquee](/docs/components/marquee.md): Scrolling text and content display with customizable speed and direction
- [Scrollspy](/docs/components/scrollspy.md): Navigation component that highlights active sections based on scroll position
- [Sidebar](/docs/components/sidebar.md): Collapsible sidebar navigation with responsive behavior
- [Sortable](/docs/components/sortable.md): Drag-and-drop sortable lists built on DnD Kit
- [Stepper](/docs/components/stepper.md): Multi-step form wizard with progress indication
- [Tree](/docs/components/tree.md): Hierarchical tree view for nested data visualization

## Radix UI Components

These components are built on Radix UI primitives with full accessibility support:

- [Accordion](/docs/components/accordion.md): Collapsible content sections with smooth animations and keyboard navigation
- [Alert](/docs/components/alert.md): Contextual feedback messages with variant styles for success, warning, and error states
- [Alert Dialog](/docs/components/alert-dialog.md): Modal dialog for important confirmations requiring user action
- [Aspect Ratio](/docs/components/aspect-ratio.md): Maintain consistent aspect ratios for images and media
- [Avatar](/docs/components/avatar.md): User profile images with fallback initials and status indicators
- [Badge](/docs/components/badge.md): Small status indicators and labels with multiple variants
- [Breadcrumb](/docs/components/breadcrumb.md): Navigation breadcrumbs showing hierarchical page location
- [Button](/docs/components/button.md): Versatile button with 8 variants, 4 sizes, and multiple modes including icon and link
- [Card](/docs/components/card.md): Container component for grouping related content with header, body, and footer
- [Carousel](/docs/components/carousel.md): Image and content carousel with navigation and autoplay
- [Checkbox](/docs/components/checkbox.md): Accessible checkbox input with indeterminate state support
- [Collapsible](/docs/components/collapsible.md): Expandable content sections with animation support
- [Command](/docs/components/command.md): Command palette for keyboard-driven navigation and search
- [Context Menu](/docs/components/context-menu.md): Right-click context menus with nested submenus
- [Datefield](/docs/components/datefield.md): Date input field with formatting and validation
- [Dialog](/docs/components/dialog.md): Modal dialogs with focus trapping and accessibility features
- [Drawer](/docs/components/drawer.md): Slide-out panel from screen edges for mobile-friendly navigation
- [Dropdown Menu](/docs/components/dropdown-menu.md): Dropdown menus with keyboard navigation and submenus
- [Hover Card](/docs/components/hover-card.md): Preview content on hover with smooth animations
- [Input](/docs/components/input.md): Text input with validation states, icons, and addons
- [Input OTP](/docs/components/input-otp.md): One-time password input with auto-focus and paste support
- [Kbd](/docs/components/kbd.md): Keyboard shortcut display component
- [Label](/docs/components/label.md): Accessible form labels with required indicator support
- [Menubar](/docs/components/menubar.md): Horizontal menu bar for application navigation
- [Navigation Menu](/docs/components/navigation-menu.md): Complex navigation with dropdowns and megamenus
- [Pagination](/docs/components/pagination.md): Page navigation with customizable page size options
- [Popover](/docs/components/popover.md): Floating content panels triggered by user interaction
- [Progress](/docs/components/progress.md): Progress indicators with percentage and indeterminate states
- [Radio Group](/docs/components/radio-group.md): Radio button groups with keyboard navigation
- [Resizable](/docs/components/resizable.md): Resizable panel layouts with draggable dividers
- [Scroll Area](/docs/components/scroll-area.md): Custom scrollbars with cross-browser consistency
- [Select](/docs/components/select.md): Dropdown select with search, multi-select, and groups
- [Separator](/docs/components/separator.md): Visual dividers for content separation
- [Sheet](/docs/components/sheet.md): Slide-out panels from any screen edge
- [Skeleton](/docs/components/skeleton.md): Loading placeholder animations
- [Slider](/docs/components/slider.md): Range slider with single or dual handles
- [Sonner](/docs/components/sonner.md): Toast notifications with rich content support
- [Spinner](/docs/components/spinner.md): Loading spinner indicators
- [Switch](/docs/components/switch.md): Toggle switch for boolean settings
- [Table](/docs/components/table.md): Data tables with sorting and custom cell rendering
- [Tabs](/docs/components/tabs.md): Tabbed content organization with keyboard navigation
- [Textarea](/docs/components/textarea.md): Multi-line text input with auto-resize support
- [Toggle](/docs/components/toggle.md): Toggle button for binary states
- [Toggle Group](/docs/components/toggle-group.md): Group of toggle buttons with single or multi-select
- [Tooltip](/docs/components/tooltip.md): Informational tooltips with customizable placement
- [Typography](/docs/components/typography.md): Text styling components for headings, paragraphs, and more

## Utilities

- [Theme Provider](/docs/components/theme-provider.md): Context provider for theme management and dark mode
- [cn utility](/docs/utilities.md): Class name merging utility using clsx and tailwind-merge
